column1: # The table of measures and coins of the appendices (progetti/appendici/appendici/misure.tex, pp. 26-28,
# PDF 3027-3029; «cifre approssimative»), by hand, one row per unit the table or its prose gives a value.
# tipo: lunghezza, capacita, peso, moneta; nome: the Italian name printed (prefLabel); originale: the
# Hebrew, Greek or Latin name printed in italics, lingua its language (he-Latn, grc-Latn, la);
# valore and unita: the value printed and its unit (QUDT: unit:CentiM, unit:M, unit:KiloM, unit:L,
# unit:GM, unit:KiloGM; stored as data); rapporto: the ratio to `base` as printed (the table's column;
# a coin's ratio is to the Attic drachma or, for the Roman ones, to the denarius); equivale: a unit the
# print says it is equivalent to; riferimenti: as printed (misprints too: paratesto.CORREZIONI_PROSA);
# parole: the words of the CEI text that name the unit (whole words, no accents; only unambiguous ones).
